sentences.text: Samuel `` Billy '' Wilder -LSB- ˈwaɪldər -RSB- -LSB- ˈvɪldɐ -RSB- -LRB- June 22 , 1906March 27 , 2002 -RRB- was an Austrian-born Jewish-American filmmaker , screenwriter , producer , artist , and journalist whose career spanned more than five decades .
He is regarded as one of the most brilliant and versatile filmmakers of Hollywood 's golden age .	Hollywood	Hollywood
With The Apartment , Wilder became the first person to win Academy Awards as producer , director , and screenwriter for the same film .	The Apartment	The Apartment	Academy Awards	Academy Awards
Wilder became a screenwriter in the late 1920s while living in Berlin .	Berlin	Berlin
After the rise of the Nazi Party , he left for Paris , where he made his directorial debut .	Nazi Party	Nazi Party	Paris	Paris

He moved to Hollywood in 1933 , and in 1939 he had a hit when he co-wrote the screenplay for the romantic comedy Ninotchka , starring Greta Garbo .	Hollywood	Hollywood	Ninotchka	Ninotchka	Greta Garbo	Greta Garbo
Wilder established his directorial reputation with an adaption of James M. Cain 's Double Indemnity -LRB- 1944 -RRB- , a film noir .	Double Indemnity	Double Indemnity (film)	film noir	film noir
Wilder co-wrote the screenplay with crime novelist Raymond Chandler .	Raymond Chandler	Raymond Chandler

Wilder earned the Best Director and Best Screenplay Academy Awards for the adaptation of a Charles R. Jackson story The Lost Weekend -LRB- 1945 -RRB- , about alcoholism .	Best Director	Academy Award for Directing	Best Screenplay	Academy Award for Writing Adapted Screenplay	Academy Awards	Academy Awards	Charles R. Jackson	Charles R. Jackson	The Lost Weekend	The Lost Weekend (film)
In 1950 , Wilder co-wrote and directed the critically acclaimed Sunset Boulevard , as well as Stalag 17 in 1953 .	Sunset Boulevard	Sunset Boulevard (film)	Stalag 17	Stalag 17
From the mid-1950s on , Wilder made mostly comedies .

Among the classics Wilder created in this period are the farces The Seven Year Itch -LRB- 1955 -RRB- and Some Like It Hot -LRB- 1959 -RRB- , and satires such as The Apartment -LRB- 1960 -RRB- .	The Apartment	The Apartment	The Seven Year Itch	The Seven Year Itch	Some Like It Hot	Some Like It Hot
He directed fourteen different actors in Oscar-nominated performances .
Wilder was recognized with the American Film Institute -LRB- AFI -RRB- Life Achievement Award in 1986 .	American Film Institute	American Film Institute
In 1988 , Wilder was awarded the Irving G. Thalberg Memorial Award .	Irving G. Thalberg Memorial Award	Irving G. Thalberg Memorial Award
In 1993 , he was awarded the National Medal of Arts .	National Medal of Arts	National Medal of Arts
